text: 0080/D mockups: the T3 sign-in button (four states, panel, phone) and four proposals (sign-out from phone, waiting state, T3 down, no push on own sign-out)

events.text: T3 sign-in button mockups (q-nxp6): PM recommends 1a, 2a, 3a

A. The mockups as proposed, with all four proposals:
1. Sign-out allowed from the phone (sign-in stays PC-only).
2. A "waiting for T3" state with Cancel while the approval page is open, 5 minutes at most.
3. T3 down: the button keeps its state; the existing "T3 unavailable" note says so.
4. No push when the user signs out themselves.
